rationale: Combined mathematical, real-model scale/repeatability and complete fresh-run artifact evidence support continuing the planned guarded comparisons. This is a scientific judgment to continue experiments with limitations, not proof of MUSA derivative correctness, method efficacy or a root-cause fix.
limitations: Old v7 episode72 failure and historical enormous gradients remain invalid/unresolved; never resume or promote their phi.
Blocking is a candidate mitigation; root cause is not established. New runs retain the original lock, immutable pins, blocking, raw-gradient evidence and preupdate guards.
H2 means the exact last two steps with a fixed earlier boundary, not the full K-step derivative.
BF16 real-model finite differences support coarse scale only and do not validate every production gradient.
Per-update CPU replay consumes saved gradients and resets from each saved state; it is not an independent derivative recomputation or a whole CPU trajectory.
No superiority, convergence, formal generalization, q_train benefit or full-protocol completion follows from training completion.
Every subsequent meta run requires its own artifact audit and scientific review. Formal knowledge is still excluded from phi training.
permission_scope: Continue the planned protocol under guards and per-meta review; do not claim the method or backend root cause validated.
